description: Source code for Scrum module in an OpenERP/Odoo project, defining models for Scrum teams, projects, sprints, backlogs, tasks, and meetings.

classes.name: scrum_team
classes.description: Model representing a Scrum team with a name and associated users.

classes.name: scrum_project
classes.description: Model extending project.project with Scrum-specific fields like product owner, tasks, sprint size, and parent project.

classes.name: scrum_sprint
classes.description: Model representing a Scrum sprint with methods to calculate progress, effective hours, and planned hours.

classes.name: scrum_product_backlog
classes.description: Model for product backlog items, including methods for progress, effectiveness, and search functionality.

classes.name: scrum_task
classes.description: Model extending project.task with Scrum-specific fields and onchange behavior.

classes.name: scrum_meeting
classes.description: Model for Scrum meetings with fields for date, questions, and associated sprint.

methods.name: _calc_progress
methods.description: Calculates the progress percentage based on backlog or task hours and progress.

methods.name: _calc_effective
methods.description: Calculates total effective hours for a sprint or backlog.

methods.name: _calc_planned
methods.description: Calculates total planned hours for a sprint or backlog.

methods.name: onchange_project_id
methods.description: Updates product owner, scrum master, and end date when project is changed in a sprint.

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Custom search for backlog items by sprint ID.
